data.desc: Sunrise Realty Trust, Inc. (Nasdaq: SUNS) ('SUNS' or the 'Company') is an institutional commercial real estate ('CRE') lender providing flexible financing solutions to sponsors of CRE projects primarily in the Southern United States. It focuses on transitional CRE business plans with the potential for near-term value creation, collateralized by top-tier assets predominantly located in established and rapidly expanding Southern markets.
